newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Harmonic, Uniphase cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Harmonic, Uniphase cut.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group said analyst Kevin Slocum lowered Harmonic Lightwaves Inc to short-term hold from buy, keeping a long-term buy rating on the stock.
-- lowered fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $0.81 a share from $0.85 and maintained 1997 estimate at $0.62 a share.
-- also downgraded Uniphase Corp to short-term hold from buy, keeping it as a long-term buy.
-- maintained earnings per share estimates of $0.92 for fiscal 1997 and $1.65 for fiscal 1998.
-- further details were not immediately available.
-- Harmonic was off 2-1/8 to 18-3/4. Uniphase fell 1-15/16 to 64-1/4.
